summary: The single declaration of the work-item operator taxonomy. This vocabulary answers what an operator says a work item IS. It is not the workflow family, which answers which workflow a work item RUNS: that set is fixed by CD-0013 D14, lives on the workflow definition, and is resolved through workflow_instances.definition_ref. The two sets are disjoint in meaning and must never be compared. Every projection of this vocabulary is derived from this file: the seeded work_kinds registry, the work_items membership trigger, the fold's create and revise gates, and the agent capture enum.
